sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: license classes, the beginner's permit, the graduated license and required tests
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Class E, F, G and M and the commercial classes are summarized only as far as this manual states them; the manual itself refers readers to separate SCDMV manuals for those licenses [A02].
The teen supervisor list is condensed; the statute citations SC Code §56-1-100 and -110 are named as the manual prints them and were not checked against the code itself [A05].
The manual writes daylight savings time; facts use the standard term daylight saving time with the same meaning [A07].
The waiver fee of twenty-five dollars and the form numbers are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic [A09].
The manual lists skills test tasks with the words could be required, so facts present them as possible tasks, not a fixed script [A12].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.

verification_debt.claim_text: The manual cites SC Code §56-1-100, §56-1-110 and §56-1-15 for teen supervisors and random skills retests (physical pages 9 to 16); the statute text was not checked in this pass.
